suspects.description: Raw hex address 0x555d7d assigned to bare local `uVar10`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `uVar10` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Watcom dead self-copy guard: `if (&local_bc != &local_194)` wraps an unconditional struct copy. Both addresses are stack locals — always different — so the guard never skips. Drop the if-wrapper in a .keep.
